answer.reason: Several passages tell what happened at Kadesh: the spies' return, Miriam's death and the rebellion at Meribah.

clauses.english: was where the spies came back with word of the land
clauses.quote: brought back word unto them, and unto all the congregation

clauses.english: was where Miriam died and was buried
clauses.quote: Miriam died there, and was buried there

clauses.english: was where Moses and Aaron rebelled at the water of Meribah
clauses.quote: the water of Meribah in Kadesh in the wilderness of Zin

doubts: Kadeshbarnea and Enmishpat are taken as the same place as Kadesh.
Verses that only give a border or a journey (GEN 14:7, NUM 34:4, JOS 15:3, EZK 47:19) were left out.
